elements.element: Customer has no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation.
elements.evidence: The clause states that M&I is a non-exclusive provider and Customer has no obligation to obtain any Services exclusively from M&I.

elements.element: Exclusivity is limited to a defined product category.
elements.evidence: The clause imposes no exclusivity and therefore does not establish a defined category for a fallback exclusivity commitment.

elements.element: Exclusivity lasts no longer than 12 months.
elements.evidence: The clause imposes no exclusivity and contains no 12-month duration cap.

elements.element: Exclusivity ends automatically if Vendor fails to meet service levels.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no automatic termination trigger tied to M&I's failure to meet service levels.

elements.element: Exclusivity ends automatically if Vendor fails to meet delivery dates.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no automatic termination trigger tied to M&I's failure to meet delivery dates.
